company.name: Juan Narro LLC
company.serviceArea: Denver Metro & Surrounding Front Range Communities • USA

services.title: Drywall
services.description: Patching holes, fixing cracks and ceiling drywall, taping, texture matching, full wall installation, and new drywall installation.

services.title: Painting & Caulking
services.description: Interior and exterior painting, room touch-ups, trim and baseboard painting, furniture moving as needed, and caulking/sealing for bathrooms, kitchens, windows, and siding gaps.

services.title: Fence Work
services.description: Wood and vinyl fence repairs, gate adjustments, replacing damaged sections, fence cleaning, and staining.

services.title: Doors & Windows
services.description: Door repairs, frame/jamb and hardware fixes, hinge adjustments, lock and handle installation, door and window replacement, attic doors, and screen repair or replacement.

services.title: Carpentry, Trim & Shelving
services.description: Baseboards, door and window casing, crown molding, chair rails, wainscoting, faux beams, stair trim, cabinet/shelving installation and repair, and furniture assembly or TV/shelf/curtain mounting.

services.title: Gutters & Exterior / Yard
services.description: Gutter cleaning, leak repair, downspout adjustments, gutter installation, deck board/railing/stair repairs, deck staining and sealing, siding repairs (wood, fiber cement/hardy, vinyl, brick, stucco), lawn mowing, leaf blowing, and yard cleanup.

services.title: Electrical & Plumbing
services.description: Light fixtures, ceiling fans, chandeliers, outlets, switches, smoke detectors, smart home device setup, faucet swaps, leaky under-sink pipes, toilet repairs, and garbage disposals.

services.title: Flooring & Garage
services.description: Installation of wood, laminate, tile (porcelain, ceramic, stone, marble), and garage door, opener, and storage/organization setup.

services.title: Commercial Maintenance
services.description: Repairs and maintenance for retail, office, and restaurant spaces—including walls, ceilings, flooring, tile, trim, lighting, and scheduling options around business hours to limit disruption.

services.title: Cleaning & Move-Out Turnovers
services.description: Deep cleaning, move-out cleaning, and apartment turnover/make-ready work, including repairing damaged walls, floors, or countertops, cleaning thoroughly, and getting the unit ready for the next tenants.

testimonials.author: Michael Vance
testimonials.text: Juan rebuilt our front brick steps and repaired a retaining wall. Clean lines, rock-solid work, and zero mess left behind.

testimonials.author: Sarah Jenkins
testimonials.text: Reliable contractors are hard to find. Juan gave a transparent estimate, showed up on schedule, and nailed the concrete patio pour.

testimonials.author: David Thorne
testimonials.text: We hire Juan for masonry, tile, and framing across our flip properties. High structural standards and fair pricing.
